name: solar
description: SOLAR - SOLution ARchitect rabbit agent: 3D AI assistant for delivering ArchiMate diagrams, sequence diagrams and Technical Specification Documents.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @solar/web && npm run build -w @solar/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @solar/shared && npm run typecheck -w @solar/server && npm run typecheck -w @solar/web && npm run typecheck -w @solar/desktop
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build && npm run start -w @solar/desktop
scripts.desktop:dist:win: npm run build && npm run dist:win -w @solar/desktop
